idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chand'ūpasaṃhitā'pi dos'ūpasaṃhitā'pi moh'ūpasaṃhitā'pi, tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tamhā nimittā aññaṃ nimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ kusal'ūpasaṃhitaṃ.

51128.commentary: (MNa) yoniso manasikāro nāma upāyamanasikāro pathamanasikāro, anicc'ādīsu aniccan'ti ādinā eva nayena sacc'ānulomikena vā cittassa āvaṭṭanā anvāvaṭṭanā ābhogo samannāhāro manasikāro, ayaṃ vuccati yoniso manasikāro'ti.

examples.text: dhātukusalatā ca manasikārakusalatā ca.

51132.commentary: (SNa) manasikārasamudayā'ti ettha pana yonisomanasikārasamudayā bojjh'aṅgadhammānaṃ samudayo, ayonisomanasikārasamudayā nīvaraṇadhammānaṃ.

examples.text: nāmarūpasamudayā cittassa samudayo, nāmarūpanirodhā cittassa atthaṅ'gamo. manasikārasamudayā dhammānaṃ samudayo, manasikāranirodhā dhammānaṃ atthaṅ'gamo'ti.

yo sugatesu manaṃ padosaye, sataṃ sahassānaṃ nirabbudānaṃ, chattiṃsatī pañca ca abbudāni, yam'ariyagarahī nirayaṃ upeti, vācaṃ manañ'ca paṇidhāya pāpakan'ti.

manaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha, man'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha. manaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto, man'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto manasmim'pi nibbindati. nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo.

51142.meaning1: belonging to the group of pleasing (gods)

51143.meaning1: acting kindly; behaving pleasantly; charming in conduct

tam'enaṃ uṭṭhahitvā apāpuritvā olokeyya. tassa saha dassanena manāpatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, appāṭikulyatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, ajegucchatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, suhitānam'pi bhottu'kamyatā assa, pag'eva jighacchitānaṃ.

51148.meaning1: which results in pleasure; which pleases

51153.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of manāpa

51154.meaning1: acts kindly (towards); behaves pleasantly (towards); is nice (to)

51155.meaning1: pleasant and unpleasant; agreeable and disagreeable

examples.text: pathavīsamaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. pathavīsamañ'hi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāp'āmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatāsati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpikesu rūpesu, amanāpiyā rūpā paṭikūlā honti
pañca bhavasātāni, manāpikā rūpā, manāpikā saddā, manāpikā gandhā, manāpikā rasā, manāpikā phoṭṭhabbā.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatāsati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpiyesu rūpesu, amanāpiyā rūpā paṭikūlā honti

51158.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of manāpa

examples.text: api ca me, āvuso, satthā pariciṇṇo dīgharattaṃ manāpen'eva, no amanāpena. etañ'hi, āvuso, sāvakassa patirūpaṃ yaṃ satthāraṃ paricareyya manāpen'eva, no amanāpena. anupavajjaṃ channo bhikkhu satthaṃ āharissatī'ti, evam'etaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, dhārehī'ti.

idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalassa iṭṭho hoti kanto manāpo. taṃ pare iṭṭhena kantena manāpena samudācaranti. tassa evaṃ hoti, yo kho my'āyaṃ puggalo iṭṭho kanto manāpo, taṃ pare iṭṭhena kantena manāpena samudācarantī'ti.

api ca me, āvuso, satthā pariciṇṇo dīgharattaṃ manāpen'eva, no amanāpena. etañ'hi, āvuso, sāvakassa patirūpaṃ yaṃ satthāraṃ paricareyya manāpen'eva, no amanāpena. anupavajjaṃ channo bhikkhu satthaṃ āharissatī'ti, evam'etaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, dhārehī'ti.

51160.meaning1: field of the mind; mental sphere

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, saḷāyatanaṃ? cakkh'āyatanaṃ, sot'āyatanaṃ, ghān'āyatanaṃ, jivh'āyatanaṃ, kāy'āyatanaṃ, man'āyatanaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saḷāyatanaṃ.
cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbānī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkh'āyatanaṃ sot'āyatanaṃ ghān'āyatanaṃ jivh'āyatanaṃ kāy'āyatanaṃ man'āyatanaṃ

51161.meaning1: power of mind; mental faculty; mind
51161.commentary: (NIDD1a) tadeva mananalakkhaṇe ind'aṭṭhaṃ kāretī'ti indriyaṃ, mano eva indriyaṃ man'indriyaṃ

examples.text: yatv'ādhikaraṇam'enaṃ man'indriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ

51162.meaning1: ending of mind; cessation of the mental faculty

examples.text: ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… man'indriyaṃ pajānanti, man'indriyasamudayaṃ pajānanti, man'indriyanirodhaṃ pajānanti, man'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānanti, te kho me, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu c'eva samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu ca brāhmaṇasammatā

51163.meaning1: leading to the ending of mind; going to the cessation of the mental faculty

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… man'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, man'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, man'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, man'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti. na me te, bhikkhave … sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.

51164.meaning1: appearance of mind; arising of the mental faculty

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… man'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, man'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, man'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, man'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti. na me te, bhikkhave … sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, man'indriyasaṃvaraṃ asaṃvutassa viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, man'indriyasaṃvaraṃ saṃvutassa viharato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.

idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… sot'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… ghān'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… jivh'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… kāy'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… man'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati.
manujassa sadā satīmato, mattaṃ jānato laddhabhojane, tanu tassa bhavanti vedanā, saṇikaṃ jīrati āyupālayan'ti.
manujassa pamattacārino, taṇhā vaḍḍhati māluvā viya, so plavatī hurā huraṃ, phalam'icchaṃ'va vanasmi vānaro.
pañcavīsasahassamhi, kappānaṃ manuj'ādhipā, abbudanirabbudāni, aṭṭhaṭṭhāsiṃsu khattiyā.

51170.meaning1: ruler of men; lord of human beings

examples.text: rājā hoti suduppadhaṃsiyo, manuj'indo manuj'ādhipati mah'ānubhāvo, tidivapuravarasamo bhavati, suravarataro'r'iva indo.

51171.meaning1: lord of men; king; (comm) foremost of men

examples.text: ṭhānañ'hi so manuj'indo, rajjaṃ laddhāna khattiyo, so kuddho rājadaṇḍena, tasmiṃ pakkamate bhusaṃ, tasmā taṃ parivajjeyya, rakkhaṃ jīvitam'attano.
khattiyā bhogirājāno, anuyantā bhavantu te, rāj'ābhirājā manuj'indo, rajjaṃ kārehi gotama.

51172.commentary: (VVa) manuñño'ti manoramo. (SaDM) manuññan'ti manaṃ ābhuso ñeti tosetī'ti manuññaṃ. ayam'attho manasaddūpapadassa āpubbassimassa ñādhātussa vasena daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso manuññabhojanaṃ bhuttāvī chaḍḍeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu tassa purisassa tasmiṃ vante puna bhottu'kamyatā assā'ti?
taṃ kammaṃ katvā kusalaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ, jaṅghā manuññā labhate susaṇṭhitā, vaṭṭā sujātā anupubbam'uggatā, uddh'aggalomā sukhumattac'otthatā.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso manuññabhojanaṃ bhuttāvī chaḍḍeyya.
appakā te manussesu, ye janā pāragāmino, ath'āyaṃ itarā pajā, tīram'ev'ānudhāvati.
tattha cakkhumā puriso majjhe ṭhito passeyya manusse gehaṃ pavisante'pi nikkhamante'pi
laddhāna manussakaṃ bhavaṃ tato caviya, puna sukataphalavipākasesakena, paṭilabhati lapanajaṃ samama'pi, suci ca suvisuddhasusukkaṃ

51179.meaning1: agreeable to humans; liked by humans; pleasing to people

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, hatthidamako mahantaṃ thambhaṃ pathaviyaṃ nikhaṇitvā āraññakassa nāgassa gīvāyaṃ upanibandhati āraññakānañ'c'eva sīlānaṃ abhinimmadanāya… gām'ante abhiramāpanāya manussakantesu sīlesu samādapanāya.

ayañ'hi devaputto pubbe manussabhūto samāno manussadaliddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ. so aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena c'eva yasasā cā'ti.

51181.meaning1: desiring humans; wanting human (flesh); (comm) wishing to harm humans

examples.text: gaṅgāya sotasmiṃ gahītanāvaṃ, luddena nāgena manussakamyā, pamocayittha balasā pasayha, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmi.

yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavā evaṃ manussagahane evaṃ manussakasaṭe evaṃ manussasāṭheyye vattamāne sattānaṃ hit'āhitaṃ jānāti. gahanañ'h'etaṃ, bhante, yadidaṃ manussā, uttānakañ'h'etaṃ, bhante, yadidaṃ pasavo.

tattha kiñ'c'āpi apādak'ādayo'pi kāyā asucī'y'eva, idh'ādhikāravasena pana ukkaṭṭhaparicchedavasena vā, yasmā vā aññe asucibhūtā'pi kāyā loṇ'ambil'ādīhi abhisaṅkharitvā manussānaṃ bhojane'pi upanīyanti, na tv'eva manussakāyo, tasmā asucitarabhāvam'assa dassento'pi dvipādako'ti āha.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃnhāto ahikuṇapena vā kukkurakuṇapena vā manussakuṇapena vā kaṇṭhe āsattena aṭṭīyeyya harāyeyya jiguccheyya

seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṃsapāti ābhatā āpaṇā vā kammārakulā vā parisuddhā pariyodātā. tam'enaṃ sāmikā ahikuṇapaṃ vā kukkurakuṇapaṃ vā manussakuṇapaṃ vā racayitvā aññissā kaṃsapātiyā paṭikujjitvā antar'āpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ.
evarūpe te, mahārāja, mahati mahabbhaye samuppanne dāruṇe manussakkhaye dullabhe manussatte kim'assa karaṇīyan'ti?

51187.commentary: (ANa) manussakhippaṃ maññe loke uppanno'ti mahājanassa sagga-mokkha-gamanamagge tattha gamananivāraṇ'atthaṃ manussakuminaṃ viya loke uppanno. (ANt) manussakhippaṃ maññe'ti manussā patitvā byasanappatti-atthaṃ oṭṭitaṃ kuminaṃ viya. ten'āha, mahājanassā'tiādi.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, nadīmukhe khippaṃ uḍḍeyya bahūnaṃ macchānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya byasanāya, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, makkhali moghapuriso manussakhippaṃ maññe loke uppanno bahūnaṃ sattānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya byasanāyā'ti.
yojanasataṃ kho, rājañña, manussagandho deve ubbādhati.

51189.commentary: (MNa) manussagahane'ti manussānaṃ ajjhāsayagahanena gahanatā, ajjhāsayassā'pi nesaṃ kilesagahanena gahanatā veditabbā. kasaṭasāṭheyyesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavā evaṃ manussagahane evaṃ manussakasaṭe evaṃ manussasāṭheyye vattamāne sattānaṃ hit'āhitaṃ jānāti. gahanañ'h'etaṃ, bhante, yadidaṃ manussā, uttānakañ'h'etaṃ, bhante, yadidaṃ pasavo.

51190.meaning1: clutch of humans; capture by human beings
51190.commentary: (SNa) na manussaggāho gahessatī'ti mahā vat'āyaṃ dārukkhandho'ti disvā, uḷumpena taramānā gantvā, gopānasīādīnaṃ atthāya manussā na gaṇhissanti.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, sace tumhe'pi… na manussaggāho gahessati, na amanussaggāho gahessati, na āvaṭṭaggāho gahessati, na antopūtī bhavissatha, evaṃ tumhe, bhikkhave, nibbānaninnā bhavissatha nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā.

51193.meaningLit: discourse on humans passing away to hell

51194.meaningLit: discourse on humans passing away to the ghost realm
51194.sanskrit: manuṣya + cyuti + paitrya + viṣaya + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

examples.text: nirayaṃ tiracchānayoniṃ, yamalokaṃ upapajjare, sace enti manussattaṃ, dalidde jāyare kule.

evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ manussattaṃ labhati. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dibbati.

jāti ca hi, ānanda, n'ābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, seyyath'idaṃ, devānaṃ vā devattāya, gandhabbānaṃ vā gandhabbattāya, yakkhānaṃ vā yakkhattāya, bhūtānaṃ vā bhūtattāya, manussānaṃ vā manussattāya, catuppadānaṃ vā catuppadattāya

51197.meaning1: becoming a human being; acquiring the human state

examples.text: yaṃ pan'etaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā kāṇakacchap'opamaṃ upadassitaṃ manussattappaṭilābhāya, tath'ūpamaṃ, mahārāja, imesaṃ samāgamaṃ dhārehi.

ayañ'hi devaputto pubbe manussabhūto samāno manussadaliddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ. so aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena c'eva yasasā cā'ti.
